newsitem.title: USA: Mission West CEO J. Gregory Kasun resigns.
newsitem.headline: Mission West CEO J. Gregory Kasun resigns.

text.p: Mission West Properties said its Chief Executive Officer and President J. Gregory Kasun resigned following completion of the company's sale of its real estate assets earlier this year.
The company said Vice President Harve Filuk also stepped down.

The company said Michael Early is the new president and CEO and Mark Foletta is the new vice president. Both are directors of the company and executive officers of Triton Group Ltd, the company's largest shareholder.
"With the completion of the sale transaction, it is now time for Mr. Filuk and me to move on to new opportunities," Kasun said.
